content.text: 99 speed @tombrady Tune in to the @fanatics Flag Football Classic this Saturday, 4pm ET on Fox Sports, Fox One, and Tubi. Tickets in Bio 🎟️Swear to god he scrambled more in his 40’s than in his 20’sImagine if this guy could throwBro has never had a bottom 10 olineHoly were so deep into offseason we’re posting Brady scramble highlights againPeople forget that @tombrady is 1st all time in rushing yards amongst all 7-time Super Bowl winning Quarterbacks. 🏃Was that a prime Brian urlacher whiffing on Brady ???@nfl I have a rule proposal that I’ve been echoing for awhile now. To fix the tush push isn’t to get rid of it but to merely change the game around it. You have to make it a penalty for the qb to cross the line of scrimmage as they were always meant to deliver the ball. This rule will also bring more clarity and value to the running back and full back positions and ultimately change how modern day football is played. I know it’s major but quarterbacks are becoming too much of a crutch in an ever growing game that we all love and we all know that other players deserve just as much as our qbs. Imagine the dynamic of qbs and coaches desperately trying to get a play across the line without a qb running or falling forward, that’s great football! Please consider it.Josh Allen is more mobile than tom BradyUrlacher knew it was time to retire after being deked out by Brady.He may not be the fastest or most agile but he had incredible pocket mobilityBrady slide is lowkey him trying to kick people lolLamar better be taking notes 🔥
